newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche to launch pre-paid card nationwide.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche to launch pre-paid card nationwide.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG, Germany's largest commercial bank, on Wednesday said it was ready to launch a pre-paid electronic chip card nationwide.

In a statement, the bank said it would spend the next few months adapting its automated teller machines to accept the cards, whose inbuilt micro chip can be "loaded" with a cash value of up to 400 marks.

Pre-paid cards, referred to as electronic purses, are a relative novelty in Germany but are being tested by several banks, including the third-largest bank Commerzbank, which plans to launch its own version next year.
Deutsche, which tested its card in the Ravensburg/Weingarten region, acknowledged that it was not yet clear how many retailers and other outlets would accept the cards.
Cards would be issued free of charge to customers until the end of this year and available at a cost of five marks each from 1997.
